themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe and the Americas are leveraging intense campaign drives, coalition maneuverings, and electoral system changes ahead of key votes. In Spain, Vox enters the final stretch of snap elections in position to shape government; in Sweden, Sverigedemokraterna's leverage over government formation stirs fierce party debates; and in the UK and Argentina, right-wing movements consolidate power through local election wins and primary reforms.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing nationalist factions across multiple nations are escalating demands for welfare chauvinism and migration restrictions, arguing national citizens must take precedence over foreign nationals. From British proposals to end graduate visas to Spanish and Norwegian budget demands prioritizing native citizens over asylum seekers, the frame of 'national priority' remains central.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Right-wing leaders across several democracies face growing legal friction, judicial blockades, and state investigations, which they frame as politized persecution. French prosecutors raid key Rassemblement National figures, Brazilian judges freeze assets of fugitive Bolsonarista politicians, and German AfD leaders prepare for potential party ban proceedings.

themes.title: Pensions Overhaul and Fiscal Populism Debates
themes.blurb: Fiscal populism and state budget battles are sparking sharp clashes across right-wing political spheres. While Norway's FrP pushes drastic spending and tax reduction plans and Argentina's government advances central bank and budget overhauls, Italian and Polish leaders face fierce domestic debate over pension funding and tax vetoes.
